rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a notice or announcement sent or given to people.

example.english: The company sent an announcement that we’re off tomorrow.
example.traditional: 公司出咗通知，聽日放假。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ceot1 zo2 tung1 zi1 ting1 jat6 fong3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for an official public announcement, especially one issued by an organization or authority.

example.english: The government issued an official announcement about the new measures.
example.traditional: 政府就新措施發出公告。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 zau6 san1 cou3 si1 faat3 ceot1 gung1 gou3
